Bug Title: Regular user can access /admin route by typing URL manually
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Login as User 2. Type https://app-url/admin in browser address bar 3. Press Enter
Expected Result: User should be redirected to their dashboard or see Access Denied page
Actual Result: Admin panel partially loads before redirect kicks in — brief data exposure possible

Bug Title: No validation on negative expense amount
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Login as User 2. Click Add Expense 3. Enter -500 in amount field 4. Submit form
Expected Result: Validation error: 'Amount must be a positive number'
Actual Result: Expense gets saved with negative value and appears in dashboard as -₹500

Bug Title: Expired JWT token returns 500 instead of 401
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Wait for token to expire (or manually set expiry) 2. Make API call to GET /api/expenses
Actual Result: HTTP 500 Internal Server Error — exposes stack trace in response body

Bug Title: Total expense amount does not update after deleting an expense
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Login 2. Note total expense amount 3. Delete one expense 4. Observe total
Expected Result: Total should decrease by the deleted amount immediately
Actual Result: Total remains unchanged until page is manually refreshed

Bug Title: Chatbot returns generic response for valid expense queries
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Login 2. Open chatbot 3. Type 'What did I spend most on this month?'
Expected Result: Chatbot responds with category breakdown from user's data
Actual Result: Chatbot responds with 'I can help with expenses' without actual data

Bug Title: Login button remains disabled briefly after correct credentials entered
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open login page 2. Quickly enter email and password 3. Click Login immediately
Expected Result: Login button should be active and respond to click
Actual Result: Button disabled for ~1 second causing user confusion

Bug Title: Date format in exported CSV uses YYYY-MM-DD instead of DD-MM-YYYY
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Login as Admin 2. Select a class 3. Click Export CSV 4. Open downloaded file 5. Check Date column
Actual Result: Dates exported as YYYY-MM-DD — causes confusion and breaks data import tools

Bug Title: User can see class list of other admins in dropdown
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Login as User 2. Open class selection dropdown
Expected Result: Only classes assigned to the logged-in user's admin should appear
Actual Result: All classes from all admins visible to any user

Bug Title: Attendance dashboard does not auto-update on slow network
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Throttle network to Slow 3G in DevTools 2. Scan RFID 3. Observe dashboard
Expected Result: Attendance should update within 5-10 seconds even on slow network
Actual Result: Dashboard requires manual refresh on connections below 1Mbps

Bug Title: Exporting attendance for empty class throws unhandled error
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Create a class with no students added 2. Click Export CSV
Expected Result: Empty CSV file downloaded with column headers only
Actual Result: Browser shows 'Something went wrong' toast — no file downloaded
